branch_crosswalk.anchor: Hysteresis of Multiconfiguration Assemblies of Nitinol and Steel Strands: Experiments and Phenomenological Identification
branch_crosswalk.proves: Classical cable strand hysteresis experiments and modeling utilize passive internal contact and geometric friction; no actively controlled transverse fluid/pneumatic confinement pressure is present.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove global novelty of MP1 or that active pneumatic confinement requires an entirely distinct constitutive coupling law.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Mechanical response of single and double-helix SMA wire ropes
branch_crosswalk.proves: SMA wire rope mechanics models inter-wire contact pressure and friction derived solely from axial tension and double-helix geometry, without active external pressure control.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove that NiTi superelasticity cannot be captured by standard parameter substitution into wire rope frameworks.

branch_crosswalk.proves: Classical formulations of internal cable friction establish slip threshold criteria based on bending curvature, but contain no active pressure confinement mechanism.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove novelty of friction laws.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: BENDING MECHANICS OF CABLE CORES AND FILLERS IN A DYNAMIC SUBMARINE CABLE
branch_crosswalk.proves: Multi-layer cable core bending mechanics models stick-slip transitions between helical components using contact mechanics derived from external hydrostatic and tension loading, not active control.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove absence of other industrial submarine cable slip patents.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: High damping capacity with a wide temperature window in braided NiTi microfilaments
branch_crosswalk.proves: Braided NiTi microfilaments achieve high damping through combined phase transformation and contact slip, but operate purely passively without actively varied pneumatic confinement.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: NiTi SMA Superelastic Micro Cables: Thermomechanical Behavior and Fatigue Life under Dynamic Loadings
branch_crosswalk.proves: Superelastic micro cables exhibit thermomechanical hysteresis under cyclic tension, but contain no active pressure chamber or variable confinement.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove that existing SMA cable contact models are unable to predict bundled response under external pressure.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Nonlinear Vibration Absorber with Pinched Hysteresis: Theory and Experiments
branch_crosswalk.proves: Pinched hysteresis in SMA/steel wire dampers is governed by geometric kinematics and passive contact preloads, not active pneumatic fluid confinement.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove active pressure mechanism is viable or unaddressed by classical damping mechanics.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Finite Element Method for Mechanical Behavior of Shape Memory Alloy Superelastic Cables (形状记忆合金超弹性缆索力学行为的有限单元法)
branch_crosswalk.proves: Finite element models of superelastic cables combine 3D beam elements with surface contact algorithms under cyclic tension without requiring external pressure field coupling.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove whether parameter substitution breaks down under transverse active pressure.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: A new mechanical model of short wire ropes: Theory and experimental validation
branch_crosswalk.proves: Short wire rope bending theory resolves internal normal force and slip transitions directly from applied tension and bending curvature; no actively varied external pressure is utilized.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Detachable Soft Actuators with Tunable Stiffness Based on Wire Jamming
branch_crosswalk.proves: Forward citations of Bai et al. up to September 2026 develop detachable soft grippers, magnetorheological fluids, and surgical tubes, but do not combine metallic wire jamming with superelastic NiTi phase transformation.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: A Positive Pressure Jamming Based Variable Stiffness Structure and its Application on Wearable Robots
branch_crosswalk.proves: Forward citations of Liu et al. extend positive-pressure jamming into wearable exosuits and medical splints using granular, layer, and fiber media, but do not explore superelastic metallic wire bundles.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove that positive pressure jamming cannot be described by standard friction mechanics.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: A variable stiffness omnidirectional chain based on positive-pressure fiber jamming
branch_crosswalk.proves: Zero forward citations were indexed in Scopus for this 2026 publication at the search cutoff date; no follow-up literature currently preempts this line.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Absence of citing literature does not prove global novelty of MP1.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Variable-Stiffness and Deformable Link Using Shape-Memory Material and Jamming Transition Phenomenon
branch_crosswalk.proves: Forward citations of Takashima et al. 2022 explore shape-memory polymer/alloy thermal transitions combined with vacuum particle/sheet jamming, but not fluid/positive pressure controlled metallic wire friction.
branch_crosswalk.does_not_prove: Does not prove coupled SMA + jamming mechanics is novel.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Effect of R-phase on shape recovery speed of Ti-Ni shape memory alloy wire for variable-stiffness mechanism using jamming transition phenomenon
branch_crosswalk.proves: The single citing publication (Takashima et al. 2026 in JRM) investigates two-arm pick-and-place manipulation using thermal R-phase SMA jamming links; it does not implement active transverse pressure control on metallic wire bundles.

branch_crosswalk.anchor: Piston-like particle jamming for enhanced stiffness adjustment of soft robotic arm
branch_crosswalk.proves: Zero forward citations were indexed in Scopus for this 2024 particle jamming paper at the search cutoff date.
